title: Policy No. 40-701 Tangible Capital Assets Policy
notes: Found by CivicWeb document search on 2026-10-21; PDF opened. Schedule "A" on p9 (folio "Page 9 of 12", footer dated September 13, 2010). The text layer prints the lives as a separate block after the labels, so every value was confirmed on a rendered image of the page: Permanent buildings - Brick, stone or cement 50; Permanent buildings - Log, frame and other 40; No foundation (eg: greenhouse) 20; Temporary/portable structures 20; Building improvements: Flooring **10, HVAC, plumbing, lighting, etc **20, where ** means subject to the remaining life of the parent asset when the improvement is not a betterment. Same construction-type rows and numbers as the Comox Valley Regional District table, which says it is based on the provincial May 2008 amortization guide.
